statement: Safe Superintelligence Inc. committed to NVIDIA's next-generation Vera Rubin platform as the basis for an order-of-magnitude increase in its compute, alongside an undisclosed NVIDIA investment in SSI.
why: A leading frontier research lab standardizing on the not-yet-shipped Vera Rubin generation locks in future accelerator demand ahead of launch.

impact.mechanism: A named frontier-lab platform commitment converts into forward purchases of next-generation GPUs and the memory and infrastructure around them.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA made a substantial (undisclosed) investment in SSI; NVIDIA's investment combined with access to the next-generation Vera Rubin platform will allow SSI to increase its compute 'by an order of magnitude'.

confidence.basis: Primary company newsroom announcement naming both parties; the qualitative commitment is directly stated, though no dollar, GPU or gigawatt figure is disclosed.
